relations.subject: Mortimer Wheeler

relations.subject: Mortimer Wheeler
relations.evidence: Upon the retirement of the Keeper of the London Museum, Harmon Oates, Wheeler was invited to fill the vacancy. He had been considering a return to London for some time and eagerly agreed, taking on the post... in July 1926.
